def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    N = int(input[0])
    s = input[1]
    count = 0
    n = len(s)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            substring = s[i:j+1]
            if substring == substring[::-1]:
                count += 1
    print(count)

main()
